item.title: Father who gave gun to Georgia school shooting suspect for Christmas is guilty of 2nd-degree murder
item.description: Jurors took less than two hours to find Colin Gray guilty of all charges in the September 2024 shooting at Apalachee High School in Winder, northeast of Atlanta. Gray is one of a number of parents prosecuted after their children were accused in fatal shootings across the country.

item.title: Questions mount in Congress over Iran war’s costs, risks and exit plan
item.description: Lawmakers are demanding answers over what is quickly becoming a widening Middle East conflict.

item.title: A large immigration detention camp in Texas is closed to visitors amid measles outbreak
item.description: There are 14 active measles cases and 112 people are being isolated at the facility.

item.title: Fearing GOP upset, top California Democrat urges lagging candidates for governor to drop out of race
item.description: The all-GOP general election is possible under California's unusual top-two primary system.

item.title: Jalen Tyson, James Harden lead Cavs past Pistons 113-109 without injured star Donovan Mitchell
item.description: By TOM WITHERS CLEVELAND (AP) — Jaylon Tyson scored 22 points, James Harden added 18 and the Cleveland Cavaliers avenged a recent loss in Detroit by beating the East-leading Pistons 113-109 on Tuesday night despite playing without injured star Donovan Mitchell. item.title: Photo gallery from ATAP vs. No. 7 Detroit Loyola in a D3 boys basketball regional semifinal
item.description: Arts & Technology Academy of Pontiac (ATAP) defeated No. 7 Detroit Loyola 83-59 in the Division 3 regional semifinal played at Clawson on Tuesday, March 3, 2026.

item.title: ATAP clamps down on No. 7 Detroit Loyola, rolls on to regional finals
item.description: The Arts and Technology Academy of Pontiac Lions roared out of the gate, and the Detroit Loyola Bulldogs never caught up as the Lions rolled to an 83-59 win in the Division 3 regional semifinals.

item.title: Adams fends off late surge from Oxford to advance to D1 regional final
item.description: It was resilience vs. resilience on Tuesday night. The calling card for both the Rochester Adams and Oxford boys basketball teams was on full display in the Division 1 regional semifinal at Waterford Mott High School.
